title: Beta Definition, Supported Matrix & Acceptance Contract
objective: Define the exact meaning of BETA_READY: supported device/OS/browser classes, required Player/GM/Creator journeys, network conditions, campaign/content scale, stability budgets, allowed defect classes, beta entry criteria and beta exit criteria.
acceptance: One versioned acceptance contract can deterministically classify a candidate as not-ready or eligible for the remaining BRP proof; unsupported environments and deferred capabilities are explicit.
boundaries: SMB-01..16 and their sealed product contracts remain completed predecessor authority.
BRP-01 is selected_not_started only and has no implementation authority until governed start.
BRP defines beta-readiness evidence and operations; it does not add or replace gameplay mechanics, canonical owner truth, family-safety policy or product rights authority.
Tester distribution, public release, paid infrastructure/providers, public community activation, billing, stores and marketing claims remain unauthorized.
BRP must complete through BRP-11 BETA_READY before normal SMB-17 external-beta activation.
